name: Enterprise Knowledge Copilot

stack.web: Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind v4
stack.data: Supabase Postgres 17, pgvector, full-text search, Auth, RLS
stack.retrieval: hybrid pgvector + tsvector, reciprocal rank fusion, optional cross-encoder

models.embeddings: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384 dims, ONNX, 0.067 GB); non-Latin questions are translated to English before embedding
models.llm: Groq primary, Gemini fallback, deterministic mock in tests

access_model.enforcement: SQL predicate inside search_chunks plus RLS policies

known_limits: The 512 MB free API instance cannot hold a larger cross-encoder; TinyBERT is the ceiling.
Free model quotas throttle; an outage is reported as a refusal with no citations.
The test-split refusal targets were missed; the measured cause is the score floor and single-citation answers.
Multi-tenant workspaces, browser upload, Google OAuth and password reset are not built.
Local pytest is blocked on Python 3.14 (no asyncpg wheel); API tests run in CI.
